data.long_meaning: The name Vijju is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijay', which means conqueror or victorious. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vijju usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name is a reminder that every individual has the potential to conquer their own inner demons and rise above their challenges with courage and grace.
